77' Arne Maier (Augsburg) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety.

67' Jackson Irvine (St. Pauli) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders.
63' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from St. Pauli comes to nothing.
61' Alexander Blessin has decided to substitute Morgan Guilavogui and he is replaced by Oladapo Afolayan (St. Pauli).
61' Phillip Tietz (Augsburg) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Samuel Essende.
60' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Dimitrios Giannoulis (Augsburg) was quite harsh and Tobias Reichel didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
55' Marius Wolf (Augsburg) is clearly in an offside position and the linesman raises his flag.
54' Some neat passing and movement from Augsburg as they ping around some short passes in order to create a new attacking opportunity.
52' The defender bravely blocks the shot from Johannes Eggestein (St. Pauli) inside the box.
51' St. Pauli keep the ball well and push forward with purpose, but here comes an interception from the opposition.

32' Marius Wolf (Augsburg) takes the corner but only sends it into a huddle of the defenders and one of them makes a good clearance.
30' Noah Weisshaupt (St. Pauli) tries to send the ball in front of the goal, but the opposition's defence averts the threat.
28' Noah Weisshaupt (St. Pauli) fails to deliver a decent cross from the corner and the ball goes out of play.
27' Morgan Guilavogui (St. Pauli) sees an unmarked teammate and attempts to send him a low pass. However, one of the defenders reads the game perfectly and averts the danger. St. Pauli win a corner.
20' Marius Wolf (Augsburg) swings in a promising cross from the free kick, but one of the defenders does a perfect job to avert the danger.
